image-convert.title: Convert image
image-convert.description: Change a picture to JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF or ICO.

image-to-svg.title: Image to SVG
image-to-svg.description: Trace a picture into a scalable vector.

image-resize.title: Resize image
image-resize.description: Set a new width and height.

image-compress.title: Compress image
image-compress.description: Make a picture smaller with little quality loss.

image-crop.title: Crop image
image-crop.description: Cut a picture down to the part you want.

image-filter.title: Image filters
image-filter.description: Grayscale, sepia, blur, sharpen and more.

image-rotate.title: Rotate image
image-rotate.description: Turn a picture by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

image-text.title: Add text to image
image-text.description: Put a caption or watermark on a picture.

image-to-pdf.title: Image to PDF
image-to-pdf.description: Turn a picture into a PDF document.

pdf-to-image.title: PDF to image
pdf-to-image.description: Turn PDF pages into JPG or PNG pictures.

video-convert.title: Convert video
video-convert.description: Change a video to MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV and more.

video-trim.title: Trim video
video-trim.description: Keep just the part of a video you want.

video-to-gif.title: Video to GIF
video-to-gif.description: Turn a clip into an animated GIF.

video-extract-audio.title: Extract audio
video-extract-audio.description: Pull the sound out of a video as MP3 or other audio.

video-remove-audio.title: Remove audio
video-remove-audio.description: Make a silent copy of a video.

video-extract-frames.title: Extract frames
video-extract-frames.description: Save the frames of a video as pictures.

video-transform.title: Crop, resize, rotate, flip
video-transform.description: Change the shape and orientation of a video.

video-speed.title: Change video speed
video-speed.description: Speed a video up, slow it down or reverse it.

video-adjust.title: Stabilize and adjust video
video-adjust.description: Steady shaky clips, change frame rate or color.

audio-convert.title: Convert audio
audio-convert.description: Change audio to MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC and more.

audio-trim.title: Trim audio
audio-trim.description: Keep just the part of a recording you want.

audio-effects.title: Audio effects
audio-effects.description: Change speed, pitch or volume; normalize or add reverb.

audio-waveform.title: Audio waveform
audio-waveform.description: Draw a picture of the sound wave.

remove-background.title: Remove background
remove-background.description: Cut the subject out of a photo as a transparent PNG.

upscale.title: AI image upscaler
upscale.description: Make a small picture bigger and sharper.

blur-faces.title: Blur faces
blur-faces.description: Hide faces in a photo to protect privacy.

redact-text.title: Redact text in image
redact-text.description: Cover personal text or all text in a picture.

remove-object.title: Remove object
remove-object.description: Erase something you do not want from a photo.

clean-voice.title: Clean voice
clean-voice.description: Make speech clearer in a recording.

remove-noise.title: Remove background noise
remove-noise.description: Reduce hiss, hum and room noise.

isolate-vocals.title: Isolate vocals
isolate-vocals.description: Pull the singing voice out of a song.

remove-vocals.title: Remove vocals
remove-vocals.description: Make an instrumental version of a song.

frame-interpolation.title: Smooth video (more FPS)
frame-interpolation.description: Add frames so motion looks smoother.

transcribe.title: Transcribe
transcribe.description: Turn speech in audio or video into text and captions.

inspect-metadata.title: Inspect metadata
inspect-metadata.description: See what hidden details a file carries.

strip-metadata.title: Remove metadata
strip-metadata.description: Strip location and camera details from a picture.

edit-metadata.title: Edit metadata
edit-metadata.description: Change the details stored in a picture.
